BrightMax needs the \"Modify system settings\" permission to set the screen brightness to maximum and put your original brightness back afterwards.\n\nOn the next screen, turn on \"Allow modifying system settings\", then come back.
To show the ON/OFF button over other apps, Android needs the \"Display over other apps\" permission.\n\nOn the next screen, find BrightMax and turn it on, then come back.
Recommended: safety alerts (heat, timer) and the OFF button use notifications.
BrightMax uses notifications for the always-visible OFF button and for safety alerts (phone too hot, low battery, timer ending). Without them you will only see short pop-up messages.

Show a draggable ON/OFF button over other apps. Long-press it to open BrightMax.
Safety: −20% at 40 °C · OFF at 43 °C · OFF below 15% battery · OFF when the screen turns off. Only official Android APIs are used; no root, no kernel or hardware changes.

Using maximum brightness (and HDR Boost) for a long time makes the phone warmer and drains the battery much faster.

BrightMax protects your phone: it lowers the boost at 40 °C, turns it off at 43 °C, below 15% battery, when the screen turns off and when the timer ends, and always restores your original brightness.

Use it only when you need it (sunlight, presentations).
Your display does not report HDR, so this may do nothing. If \"HDR headroom now\" stays at 1.00× or \"Not reported\" while boosting, this phone does not allow extra HDR brightness.
